STEP 7 - Energy: Fresh white cheese (paneer-type) ≈ 300 kcal/100 g → 390 g ≈ 1170 kcal. Papaya ≈ 43 kcal/100 g → 115 g ≈ 50 kcal.

STEP 8 - Sanity check: A ~500 g plate with cheese dominating is plausible for what is visible. The cheese estimate is large for a snack, so I'll note the uncertainty; the photo may show a generous portion. Total ≈ 505 g, ≈ 1220 kcal.
